name: fireworks
summary:
Successfully completed the Fireworks quickstart and received a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The response "Hola" was returned.

Steps completed:
1. Fetched the quickstart page at https://docs.fireworks.ai/getting-started/quickstart
2. Verified FIREWORKS_API_KEY was already exported in the sandbox environment
3. Confirmed the OpenAI Python SDK was installed (`pip install openai`)
4. Wrote the quickstart Python script using the OpenAI SDK with `base_url="https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1"`
5. The model specified in the docs (`accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`) returned a 404 "Model not found" error
6. Listed available models via the API to find a valid substitute
7. Updated the script to use `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-pro` (confirmed available)
8. Ran the script successfully and received the chat completion response: "Hola"
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, but that model returned a 404 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed' error. I had to query the available models endpoint and substitute `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-pro` (another DeepSeek model from the same provider) to get a successful response. This is a deviation from the exact code snippet in the docs.
